questions.question: A certain sum of money is given at a certain rate of simple interest for 6 years. Had it been given at 7% higher rate, it would have fetched ₹1,512 more. Find the sum (in ₹).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total additional interest percentage = Time × Extra Rate = 6 × 7% = 42%

This 42% additional interest on the principal corresponds to ₹1512.

Since Principal is always exactly 100%, we calculate:

Principal (100%) = (1512 ÷ 42) × 100

Principal = 36 × 100 = ₹3600

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time (T) = 6 years

Increase in Rate of Interest = 7%

Increase in Simple Interest = ₹1512

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Difference in SI = (P × Change in Rate × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50d33c87fb761de75ae632ec99670dce420c9d71476105aedf523388997fc6e8.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the initial principal sum be P.

⇒ The additional interest earned is strictly due to the extra 7% rate applied over the 6 years duration.

⇒ Total extra interest percentage = 7% × 6 = 42%

⇒ According to the question, this 42% of P equals ₹1512.

⇒ (42 ÷ 100) × P = 1512

⇒ P = (1512 × 100) ÷ 42

⇒ P = 36 × 100

⇒ P = 3600

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Direct Proportionality in Simple Interest

Simple Interest is directly proportional to the Principal, Rate, and Time. If only the Rate increases by an amount, say r%, the extra interest is calculated directly as Extra SI = (P × r × T) ÷ 100.

Amount in Simple Interest

The final amount obtained after time T is the sum of the Principal and the accumulated Simple Interest. Formula: A = P + SI = P × [1 + (R × T) ÷ 100].

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

In Simple Interest, the principal remains the same every year and interest does not compound. In Compound Interest, the interest earned in previous years is added back to the principal, yielding interest on interest.

questions.question: A chord of length 32 cm is drawn at a distance of 12 cm from the centre of a circle. Find the radius of the circle.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The perpendicular from the centre bisects the chord, so half the chord is 32 ÷ 2 = 16 cm.

The radius, distance from the centre, and half-chord form a right-angled triangle.

Recognize the common Pythagorean triplet (12, 16, 20), which is a multiple of the (3, 4, 5) base triplet.

Hence, the radius of the circle is 20 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2039b86ded3026a53c6b33beb7ba06ef4d35b5605408d21805881c00212a8b35.png] 

**Given:**

Length of the chord (AB) = 32 cm

Distance of the chord from the centre (OM) = 12 cm

**Formula Used:**

Pythagoras Theorem: Hypotenuse² = Perpendicular² + Base²

**Calculations:**

⇒ The perpendicular drawn from the centre of a circle to a chord bisects the chord.

⇒ Therefore, AM = MB = 32 ÷ 2 = 16 cm.

⇒ In right-angled triangle ΔOMB,

⇒ OB² = OM² + MB²

⇒ Radius (r)² = 12² + 16²

⇒ r² = 144 + 256

⇒ r² = 400

⇒ r = √400 = 20 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 20 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Perpendicular from Centre to Chord

A perpendicular drawn from the centre of a circle to a chord bisects the chord into two equal halves. Conversely, a line drawn through the centre of a circle to bisect a chord is perpendicular to the chord.

Equal Chords and Distance

Equal chords of a circle are equidistant from the centre. Similarly, chords that are equidistant from the centre of a circle are always equal in length.

Intersecting Chords Theorem

If two chords AB and CD intersect internally at a point P, then the product of their respective line segments is always equal: AP × PB = CP × PD.
</p

questions.question:
A shopkeeper offers the following discount schemes for buyers.

I. Two successive discounts of 15% and 20%

II. Successive discount of 25 % and 10%

III. A discount of 33%

The selling price will be minimum under the scheme:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective discount formula = x + y − (x × y) ÷ 100

Discount I = 15 + 20 − (15 × 20) ÷ 100 = 32%

Discount II = 25 + 10 − (25 × 10) ÷ 100 = 32.5%

Discount III = 33%

Selling price is minimum when discount is maximum, which is 33%.

**∴ The correct answer is Scheme III.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three discount schemes:

I. Successive discounts of 15% and 20%

II. Successive discount of 25% and 10%

III. A discount of 33%

**Formula Used:**

Effective Discount = x + y − (x × y) ÷ 100

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c94657fbcb46655d5875ab0608b4960760ec6d31095893b74f58ee609a916aa5.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Scheme I Discount = 15 + 20 − (15 × 20) ÷ 100 = 35 − 3 = 32%

⇒ Scheme I Selling Price = 100% − 32% = 68% of Marked Price

⇒ Scheme II Discount = 25 + 10 − (25 × 10) ÷ 100 = 35 − 2.5 = 32.5%

⇒ Scheme II Selling Price = 100% − 32.5% = 67.5% of Marked Price

⇒ Scheme III Discount = 33%

⇒ Scheme III Selling Price = 100% − 33% = 67% of Marked Price

⇒ Comparing the Selling Prices: 67% [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

When two discounts x% and y% are given consecutively on an item, the equivalent single discount is given by the formula [x + y − (x × y) ÷ 100]%.

Marked Price vs Selling Price

The selling price is calculated after applying the discount on the marked price. It can be found directly using the formula: SP = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100.

Maximising Discount for Consumer

For a consumer, if the sum of successive discounts given in different schemes is the same, the sequence with the largest numerical difference between the individual discounts always yields a higher overall discount.
</p

questions.question: The perimeter of a rectangular garden is 48 m. If the length is 6 m more than the breadth, the area (in m²) of the garden is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of Length (L) and Breadth (B) = Perimeter ÷ 2 = 48 ÷ 2 = 24 m

Given the difference L − B = 6 m

L = (24 + 6) ÷ 2 = 15 m

B = (24 − 6) ÷ 2 = 9 m

Area = L × B = 15 × 9 = 135 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 135 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Perimeter of rectangular garden = 48 m

Length (L) = Breadth (B) + 6 m

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b3c8a5077d25803edb0573b2cf36f111ae87860c2a822466ea795cd5a96285e.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(L + B)

Area of rectangle = L × B

**Calculation:**

⇒ 2(B + 6 + B) = 48

⇒ 2(2B + 6) = 48

⇒ 2B + 6 = 24

⇒ 2B = 18

⇒ B = 9 m

⇒ L = 9 + 6 = 15 m

⇒ Area = L × B

⇒ Area = 15 × 9 = 135 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 135 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Rectangle

Opposite sides are equal and parallel. All interior angles are exactly 90°.

Diagonal of a Rectangle

Length of diagonal = √(L² + B²). Diagonals are equal in length and bisect each other.

Square as a Rectangle

A square is a special type of rectangle where Length = Breadth. For a square, Area = Side² and Perimeter = 4 × Side.
</p

questions.question: If three cubes of volume 512 cm³ each are joined end to end, find the surface area of the resulting cuboid.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of each cube (a) = ³√512 = 8 cm.

When 'n' cubes are joined end-to-end, the total surface area = (4n + 2)a².

For 3 cubes, Surface area = (4 × 3 + 2)a² = 14a².

⇒ 14 × (8)² = 14 × 64 = 896 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 896 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume of each cube = 512 cm³

Number of cubes joined = 3

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cube = a³ (where a is the side length)

Surface area of cuboid = 2 × (lb + bh + hl)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca8a64a34153c8e2edf003dad21792b030db2a6b68585a53a2799bf33b5470e7.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ a³ = 512

⇒ a = ³√512 = 8 cm

When 3 cubes are joined end to end, a resulting cuboid is formed with dimensions:

⇒ Length (l) = 8 + 8 + 8 = 24 cm

⇒ Breadth (b) = 8 cm

⇒ Height (h) = 8 cm

⇒ Surface Area = 2 × (lb + bh + hl)

⇒ Surface Area = 2 × (24×8 + 8×8 + 8×24)

⇒ Surface Area = 2 × (192 + 64 + 192)

⇒ Surface Area = 2 × 448 = 896 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 896 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cubes Joined

When 'n' cubes of side 'a' are joined in a row, the exposed surface area becomes (4n + 2)a² because (2n − 2) connecting faces become hidden.

Volume of the New Cuboid

The volume of the resulting cuboid is simply the sum of the individual volumes, calculated as n × a³.

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The length of the longest internal diagonal inside a cuboid is determined using the formula √(l² + b² + h²).
</p

questions.question: A number r when divided by 8 leaves remainder 3. What will be the remainder when (r² +6r + 7) is divided by 8?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By using the remainder directly, substitute r = 3 into the given polynomial expression.

⇒ r² + 6r + 7

⇒ (3)² + 6 × 3 + 7

⇒ 9 + 18 + 7 = 34

Now, find the remainder when 34 is divided by 8.

⇒ 34 ÷ 8 gives a remainder of 2.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A number r leaves a remainder of 3 when divided by 8.

**Formula Used:**

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

**Calculations:**

Let the quotient be k. We can write the number as:

⇒ r = 8k + 3

Substitute the value of r in the expression (r² + 6r + 7):

⇒ (8k + 3)² + 6 × (8k + 3) + 7

⇒ (64k² + 48k + 9) + (48k + 18) + 7

⇒ 64k² + 96k + 34

Now, break 34 into 32 + 2 to factor out 8:

⇒ 64k² + 96k + 32 + 2

⇒ 8 × (8k² + 12k + 4) + 2

The first term is completely divisible by 8 as it is a multiple of 8.

⇒ The remaining part is 2.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Remainder Theorem Application

When solving questions related to remainders of algebraic expressions, if a variable x leaves remainder a when divided by n, the expression P(x) will leave the same remainder as P(a) divided by n.

Modular Arithmetic Properties

Addition Rule: (A + B) mod n = [(A mod n) + (B mod n)] mod n. This allows simplifying each term individually before taking the final remainder.

Divisibility Rule of 8

A number is exactly divisible by 8 if the number formed by its last three digits is a multiple of 8.
</p

questions.question: {If } sec(t) = (x)/(y), { then } cot(t) { is equal to:}
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Using the trigonometric identity: 1 + tan²(t) = sec²(t)

⇒ tan²(t) = (x/y)² − 1 = (x² − y²) / y²

⇒ tan(t) = √(x² − y²) / y

⇒ cot(t) = 1 / tan(t) = y / √(x² − y²)

**∴ The correct answer is y / √(x² − y²).**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

sec(t) = x / y

**Formula Used:**

sec(θ) = Hypotenuse / Base

cot(θ) = Base / Perpendicular

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfb30e873664db257f2245eceaf9e35ca08e2ef24c613642182b5a1c43ffa228.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the right-angled triangle be ΔABC with a right angle at B and angle t at vertex C.

⇒ From sec(t) = x / y, we assign Hypotenuse (AC) = x and Base (BC) = y.

⇒ By Pythagoras Theorem: Hypotenuse² = Perpendicular² + Base²

⇒ x² = Perpendicular² + y²

⇒ Perpendicular (AB) = √(x² − y²)

⇒ The value of cot(t) represents the ratio of the Base to the Perpendicular.

⇒ cot(t) = y / √(x² − y²)

**∴ The correct answer is y / √(x² − y²).**

**__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

The fundamental identities linking basic trigonometric functions are: sin²(θ) + cos²(θ) = 1, sec²(θ) − tan²(θ) = 1, and cosec²(θ) − cot²(θ) = 1.

Pythagoras Theorem

For any right-angled triangle, the square of the longest side (hypotenuse) equals the sum of the squares of the base and perpendicular: H² = P² + B².

Trigonometric Ratios

Basic ratios include sin(θ) = P / H, cos(θ) = B / H, and tan(θ) = P / B. Their corresponding reciprocals are cosec(θ), sec(θ), and cot(θ).
</p

questions.question:
Simplify the following:

[ ( 5 (1)/(2) - 3 (1)/(3) ) { of } 1 (5)/(13) + 1 - 2 times 3 (5)/(2) div 2 (3)/(4) ]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

[ ( 5(1)/(2) - 3(1)/(3) ) { of } 1(5)/(13) + 1 - 2 times 3(5)/(2) div 2(3)/(4) ]

**Formula used:**

1. Mixed fraction: (a(b)/(c) = (ac + b)/(c))

2. "of" means multiplication

3. Division: (a div b = a times (1)/(b))

**Calculations:**

Convert all mixed fractions into improper fractions:

5((1)/(2) = (11)/(2)), 3((1)/(3) = (10)/(3)), 1((5)/(13) = (18)/(13)), 3((5)/(2) = (11)/(2)), 2((3)/(4) = (11)/(4))

Step 1: Subtraction inside brackets

((11)/(2) - (10)/(3) = ((11 times 3) - (10 times 2))/(6))

⇒ ((33 - 20)/(6) = (13)/(6))

Step 2: Multiply with (1(5)/(13) = (18)/(13))

((13)/(6) times (18)/(13) = (13 times 18)/(6 times 13))

⇒ ((18)/(6) = 3)

Step 3: Simplify (2 times 3(5)/(2) div 2(3)/(4))

(3(5)/(2) = (11)/(2), 2(3)/(4) = (11)/(4))

Division:

((11)/(2) div (11)/(4) = (11)/(2) times (4)/(11) = (44)/(22) = 2)

Multiply by 2: (2 times 2 = 4)

Step 4: Add and subtract remaining terms (3 + 1 - 4)

⇒ 3 + 1 = 4

⇒ 4 - 4 = 0

**∴ The simplified value is 0.**

questions.question: Find the mean proportional of 36 and 100.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mean proportional between any two numbers a and b is given directly by the square root of their product.

⇒ Mean proportional = √(a × b)

⇒ Mean proportional = √(36 × 100)

⇒ Mean proportional = 6 × 10 = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The two given numbers are 36 and 100.

**Formula Used:**

If x is the mean proportional between a and b, then a : x :: x : b, which implies the product of extremes equals the product of means.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4999f36875c51053743a3c9640e73eba45018f32a3b5bfef153b76c117c1725.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the mean proportional be x.

⇒ 36 : x = x : 100

⇒ x × x = 36 × 100

⇒ x² = 3600

⇒ x = √3600

⇒ x = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

For any two numbers a and b, the mean proportional is their geometric mean, calculated as √(a × b).

Third Proportional

For two numbers a and b, the third proportional c satisfies a : b :: b : c, which results in the formula c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

For three numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional d satisfies a : b :: c : d, yielding the formula d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Compound Ratio

When two or more ratios are multiplied together, the resultant ratio is called a compound ratio. For ratios a:b and c:d, it is (a × c) : (b × d).
</p

questions.question: In a constituency, 45% of the total number of voters are males and the rest are females. If 60% of the males are illiterate and 60% of the females are literate, then by what per cent is the number of illiterate females more than that of literate males? (Rounded off to 2 decimal places)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume total voters = 100, then Males = 45 and Females = 55.

Literate males = 40% of 45 = 18.

Illiterate females = 40% of 55 = 22.

Required % = [(22 − 18) ÷ 18] × 100 = (4 ÷ 18) × 100 = 22.22%.

**∴ The correct answer is 22.22%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total males = 45% of total voters

Illiterate males = 60% of total males

Literate females = 60% of total females

**Formula Used:**

Percentage More = (Difference ÷ Base Value) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8bba50bbe023284b4101b279c251267ae3bb906570567dcb11dc94b615d4d6c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total number of voters in the constituency be 100.

⇒ Number of male voters = 45% of 100 = 45

⇒ Number of female voters = 100 − 45 = 55

⇒ Since 60% of males are illiterate, literate males = (100 − 60)% of 45

⇒ Literate males = 40% of 45 = 18

⇒ Since 60% of females are literate, illiterate females = (100 − 60)% of 55

⇒ Illiterate females = 40% of 55 = 22

⇒ Difference between illiterate females and literate males = 22 − 18 = 4

⇒ Required percentage = (4 ÷ 18) × 100

⇒ Required percentage = (2 ÷ 9) × 100 = 22.22%

**∴ The correct answer is 22.22%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Base Value in Percentages

The term immediately following 'than' or 'of' in a question generally determines the base value (denominator) for percentage calculations.

Percentage Change

Formula: [(Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value] × 100. A positive result indicates a percentage increase, and a negative result indicates a decrease.

Successive Percentage

When multiple percentage changes occur successively, the effective percentage change is calculated using: a + b + (a × b) ÷ 100.
</p

questions.question: The sum of five consecutive numbers is 80. Find the largest number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For an odd number of consecutive terms, the average is always the exact middle number.

Average (Middle number) = Total Sum ÷ Number of terms

Middle number = 80 ÷ 5 = 16

Since the middle (3rd) number is 16, the consecutive series is: 14, 15, 16, 17, 18.

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The sum of five consecutive numbers is 80.

**Formula Used:**

If the first number is x, then 5 consecutive numbers are x, x + 1, x + 2, x + 3, and x + 4.

questions.question: A shopkeeper sold (5)/(8) of his articles at a gain of 20% and the remaining at the cost price. What is his gain percentage in the whole transaction?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Net Gain % = Sum of (Part fraction × Gain/Loss % of that part)

Gain on ⁵/₈ part = 20%

Gain on remaining ³/₈ part = 0% (since sold at Cost Price)

Net Gain % = (⁵/₈ × 20%) + (³/₈ × 0%)

Net Gain % = ¹⁰⁰/₈% = 12.5% = 12 ¹/₂%

**∴ The correct answer is 12 ¹/₂%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Fraction of articles sold at 20% gain = ⁵/₈

Remaining fraction sold at cost price (0% gain) = 1 − ⁵/₈ = ³/₈

**Formula Used:**

Overall Gain % = (Total Profit ÷ Total Cost Price) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/395f7cfa33186357fb684c758f9ee30e491b06e5bce56dbbfdb89e20b874d116.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the total number of articles be 8 and the CP of each article be 100.

⇒ Total CP = 8 × 100 = 800

⇒ SP of 5 articles (sold at 20% gain) = 5 × 100 × 1.20 = 600

⇒ SP of 3 articles (sold at CP) = 3 × 100 = 300

⇒ Total SP = 600 + 300 = 900

⇒ Total Profit = Total SP − Total CP = 900 − 800 = 100

⇒ Overall Gain % = (100 ÷ 800) × 100

⇒ Overall Gain % = ¹⁰⁰/₈ = 12.5% = 12 ¹/₂%

**∴ The correct answer is 12 ¹/₂%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Net Profit Percentage Rule

When goods are sold in multiple parts, the net profit or loss percentage is the weighted average of the profit/loss percentages of each part: Net % = (Part₁ × %₁) + (Part₂ × %₂) + ...

Selling at Cost Price

If any part of the total quantity is sold exactly at the cost price, the profit or loss on that particular fraction is 0%, effectively making its contribution to the net percentage equation zero.

Assuming Favourable Values

To avoid complex fractional calculations, it is always best to assume the total quantity to be equal to the LCM of the denominators of the given fractions (e.g., assuming total 8 articles when dealing with ⁵/₈).
</p

questions.question: Pipe X can fill a tank in 60 hours while pipe Y can fill the tank in 72 hours. Both pipes are opened together for 20 hours. How much of the tank is left empty?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Part of the tank filled by X in 20 hours = 20 ÷ 60 = 1/3

Part of the tank filled by Y in 20 hours = 20 ÷ 72 = 5/18

Total part filled by both in 20 hours = 1/3 + 5/18 = 6/18 + 5/18 = 11/18

Part of the tank left empty = 1 − 11/18 = 7/18

**∴ The correct answer is 7/18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Pipe X to fill the tank = 60 hours

Time taken by Pipe Y to fill the tank = 72 hours

Time for which both pipes are opened = 20 hours

**Concept Used:**

Total capacity of the tank = LCM of the individual times

Efficiency = Total capacity ÷ Time taken

 
 

 **Pipe**
 **Hours**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 X
 60
 360
 6
 
 

 Y
 72
 5
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total efficiency of X and Y together = 6 + 5 = 11 units/hour

⇒ Work done by both pipes in 20 hours = 11 × 20 = 220 units

⇒ Remaining work (empty part of the tank) = Total capacity − Work done

⇒ Remaining work = 360 − 220 = 140 units

⇒ Fraction of the tank left empty = Remaining work ÷ Total capacity

⇒ Fraction left = 140 ÷ 360 = 14/36 = 7/18

**∴ The correct answer is 7/18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inlet and Outlet Pipes

An inlet pipe fills a tank and its work is considered positive, whereas an outlet pipe empties the tank and its work is considered negative.

Combined Time Formula

If pipe A can fill a tank in x hours and pipe B can fill it in y hours, they together will fill the tank in (x × y) ÷ (x + y) hours.

Total Capacity (LCM Method)

The most efficient way to solve pipe & cistern problems is to assume the total capacity of the tank as the LCM of all given times.
</p

questions.question: If x = 7 - 4sqrt{3} , then find the value of ( x² + (1)/(x²) ).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x = a − √b and a² − b = 1, then 1/x = a + √b.

Here, 7² − (4√3)² = 49 − 48 = 1, so 1/x = 7 + 4√3.

⇒ x + 1/x = (7 − 4√3) + (7 + 4√3) = 14

⇒ x² + 1/x² = k² − 2 = 14² − 2 = 196 − 2 = 194

**∴ The correct answer is 194.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x = 7 − 4√3

**Formula Used:**

(a − b)(a + b) = a² − b²

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculations:**

⇒ 1/x = 1 / (7 − 4√3)

⇒ Rationalizing the denominator by multiplying the numerator and denominator by (7 + 4√3):

⇒ 1/x = (7 + 4√3) / [(7 − 4√3)(7 + 4√3)]

⇒ 1/x = (7 + 4√3) / (7² − (4√3)²)

⇒ 1/x = (7 + 4√3) / (49 − 48)

⇒ 1/x = 7 + 4√3

⇒ Now, x + 1/x = (7 − 4√3) + (7 + 4√3)

⇒ x + 1/x = 14

⇒ Squaring both sides:

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 14²

⇒ x² + 1/x² + 2(x)(1/x) = 196

⇒ x² + 1/x² + 2 = 196

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 196 − 2 = 194

**∴ The correct answer is 194.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rationalization Concept

If the difference between the squares of two terms in a binomial surd is 1, then its reciprocal is simply its conjugate. For example, if a = √p + √q and p − q = 1, then 1/a = √p − √q.

Important Algebraic Identities

If x + 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² − 2.

Higher Power Identities

If x + 1/x = k, then x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k. Also, x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = (k² − 2)² − 2.

questions.question:
If the system of the following equations has the value of the variables as three consecutive integers, then the value of a is ____.

x - y + z = 2a

x + 4y - 2z = 3(4 - a)

2x - 3y + 4z = 6 - 2a
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve for x, y, z in terms of a using basic elimination: we get x = 3a, y = 6 − 4a, and z = 6 − 5a.

The difference between y and z is y − z = (6 − 4a) − (6 − 5a) = a.

For x, y, z to be three consecutive integers, the difference between any two must be an integer and cannot exceed 2.

From the given options, substituting a = 1 gives x = 3, y = 2, z = 1, which perfectly forms a set of three consecutive integers (1, 2, 3).

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x − y + z = 2a ... (i)

x + 4y − 2z = 12 − 3a ... (ii)

2x − 3y + 4z = 6 − 2a ... (iii)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Multiply equation (i) by 2 and add to equation (ii):

⇒ 2(x − y + z) + (x + 4y − 2z) = 4a + 12 − 3a

⇒ 2x − 2y + 2z + x + 4y − 2z = a + 12

⇒ 3x + 2y = a + 12 ... (iv)

⇒ Multiply equation (i) by 4 and subtract equation (iii):

⇒ 4(x − y + z) − (2x − 3y + 4z) = 8a − (6 − 2a)

⇒ 4x − 4y + 4z − 2x + 3y − 4z = 8a − 6 + 2a

⇒ 2x − y = 10a − 6 ... (v)

⇒ Multiply equation (v) by 2 and add to equation (iv):

⇒ 2(2x − y) + (3x + 2y) = 2(10a − 6) + (a + 12)

⇒ 4x − 2y + 3x + 2y = 20a − 12 + a + 12

⇒ 7x = 21a

⇒ x = 3a

⇒ Substitute x = 3a into equation (v):

⇒ 2(3a) − y = 10a − 6

⇒ 6a − y = 10a − 6

⇒ y = 6 − 4a

⇒ Substitute x = 3a and y = 6 − 4a into equation (i):

⇒ 3a − (6 − 4a) + z = 2a

⇒ 7a − 6 + z = 2a

⇒ z = 6 − 5a

⇒ Since x, y, and z are consecutive integers, let us check the difference between them.

⇒ y − z = (6 − 4a) − (6 − 5a) = a

⇒ For the variables to be consecutive integers, the absolute difference between any two cannot exceed 2.

⇒ Substitute a = 1 from the given options:

⇒ x = 3(1) = 3

⇒ y = 6 − 4(1) = 2

⇒ z = 6 − 5(1) = 1

⇒ The values 1, 2, and 3 correctly form a set of three consecutive integers.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

System of Linear Equations

A system of three linear equations can be solved by progressively eliminating variables until a single variable remains. Substitution and coefficient matching (addition/subtraction) are the most common algebraic methods.

Consecutive Integers

A sequence of integers where each number is exactly 1 more than the previous number. The maximum difference between the largest and the smallest number in a set of three consecutive integers is exactly 2.
</p

If the expenditure on an advertisement is ₹2.1 crore, then the difference between the expenditure on transport and taxes is?

**Given:**

Expenditure on advertisement: ₹2.1 crore

Percentage of total expenditure on advertisement: 15%

Percentage of total expenditure on transport: 12.5%

Percentage of total expenditure on taxes: 10%

Total Expenditure = Expenditure on Advertisement ÷ (Percentage on Advertisement ÷ 100)

Expenditure on Transport = Total Expenditure × (Percentage on Transport ÷ 100)

Expenditure on Taxes = Total Expenditure × (Percentage on Taxes ÷ 100)

Difference = Expenditure on Transport - Expenditure on Taxes

**Calculations:**

Step 1: Calculate Total Expenditure

Total Expenditure = ₹2.1 crore ÷ (15 ÷ 100)

⇒ Total Expenditure = ₹2.1 crore ÷ 0.15

⇒ Total Expenditure = ₹14 crore

Step 2: Calculate Expenditure on Transport

Expenditure on Transport = ₹14 crore × (12.5 ÷ 100)

⇒ Expenditure on Transport = ₹14 crore × 0.125

⇒ Expenditure on Transport = ₹1.75 crore

⇒ Expenditure on Taxes = ₹14 crore × 0.10

⇒ Expenditure on Taxes = ₹1.4 crore

Step 4: Calculate the Difference

Difference = Expenditure on Transport - Expenditure on Taxes

⇒ Difference = ₹1.75 crore - ₹1.4 crore

⇒ Difference = ₹0.35 crore

**∴ The difference between the expenditure on transport and taxes is ₹35 Lakh.**

questions.question: At what angle theta , the value of sin (theta) and cos (theta) will have the same value?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given that sin(θ) = cos(θ).

Divide both sides by cos(θ) to get the ratio.

⇒ sin(θ) ÷ cos(θ) = 1

⇒ tan(θ) = 1

From the standard trigonometric table, we know that tan(45°) = 1.

**∴ The correct answer is 45°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77f74843a5c1e1f4bb66a2a16035000883aad9916a9b1b627d5757eae1c81bc6.png] 

**Given:**

An equation where sin(θ) and cos(θ) are equal.

**Concept Used:**

In a right-angled triangle, if the Perpendicular and Base are equal in length, the corresponding acute angle θ is 45°.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Perpendicular = 1 unit and Base = 1 unit.

⇒ Hypotenuse = √(1² + 1²) = √2 units.

⇒ sin(45°) = Perpendicular ÷ Hypotenuse = 1 ÷ √2

⇒ cos(45°) = Base ÷ Hypotenuse = 1 ÷ √2

⇒ Therefore, at θ = 45°, both trigonometric functions yield the exact same value of 1 ÷ √2.

**∴ The correct answer is 45°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Complementary Angles Rule

Since sin(90° − θ) = cos(θ), equating sin(θ) = cos(θ) implies sin(θ) = sin(90° − θ). Solving this gives θ = 90° − θ, which means 2θ = 90° ⇒ θ = 45°.

Key Trigonometric Values at 45°

At 45°, both sine and cosine are equal (1 ÷ √2), both tangent and cotangent are equal (1), and both secant and cosecant are equal (√2).

Quadrants and Equality

Sine and Cosine are positive and equal at 45° (1st quadrant). They are both negative and equal at 225° (3rd quadrant) where both are −(1 ÷ √2).
</p

questions.question: In a circle with centre O, AOC is the diameter. B is a point on the circumference of the circle such that arc AB is (1/5) of the arc BC. What is the degree measure of angleBOC?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The central angle subtended by an arc is directly proportional to its arc length.

Given the ratio of Arc AB to Arc BC is 1 : 5, the ratio of their central angles ∠AOB : ∠BOC is also 1 : 5.

Since AOC is a diameter, the total angle on the straight line is 180°.

∠BOC = [5 ÷ (1 + 5)] × 180°

∠BOC = (5 ÷ 6) × 180° = 150°.

**∴ The correct answer is 150°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

AOC is the diameter of the circle with centre O.

Arc AB = (1 ÷ 5) × Arc BC

**Concept Used:**

The angle subtended by an arc at the centre is directly proportional to the length of the arc.

The angle of a straight line (diameter) at the centre is 180°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e45e140ba434bd89b0162d68ccae719ecd7865c381cf4758a62171218710d2b.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the length of Arc AB be x.

⇒ Then, the length of Arc BC = 5x.

⇒ Ratio of ∠AOB to ∠BOC = Arc AB : Arc BC = x : 5x = 1 : 5.

⇒ Let ∠AOB = k and ∠BOC = 5k.

⇒ Since AOC is a straight line, the sum of angles on one side is 180°.

⇒ ∠AOB + ∠BOC = 180°

⇒ k + 5k = 180°

⇒ 6k = 180°

⇒ k = 30°

⇒ Therefore, ∠BOC = 5k = 5 × 30° = 150°

**∴ The correct answer is 150°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arc and Angle Proportion Rule

In any given circle, the central angle subtended by an arc is completely proportional to its physical arc length. (∠ ∝ Arc length).

Semicircle Property

The arc of a semicircle subtends exactly 180° at the centre of the circle and 90° at any point on the remaining circumference.

Inscribed Angle Theorem

The angle subtended by an arc at the centre is exactly double the angle subtended by the same arc at any remaining part of the circle's boundary.

questions.question:
A circular arc whose radius is 24 cm makes an angle of 60° at the centre. The perimeter of the sector formed is:

(Use π = 3.14)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The perimeter of a circular sector is the sum of its arc length and twice its radius.

Perimeter (P) = 2r + (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr

⇒ P = (2 × 24) + (60° ÷ 360°) × 2 × 3.14 × 24

⇒ P = 48 + (1 ÷ 6) × 150.72

⇒ P = 48 + 25.12 = 73.12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 73.12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius (r) = 24 cm

Central angle (θ) = 60°

π = 3.14

**Formula Used:**

Length of Arc (l) = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr

Perimeter of Sector = Length of Arc + 2 × Radius

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63b4ecb63546ed2957f5641bec6c057985e3690c6da46ba62b7194639f66e2b4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Length of Arc (l) = (60° ÷ 360°) × 2 × 3.14 × 24

⇒ l = (1 ÷ 6) × 150.72

⇒ l = 25.12 cm

⇒ Perimeter = 25.12 + 24 + 24

⇒ Perimeter = 73.12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 73.12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Sector

The area enclosed by the sector is calculated using the formula: Area = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr² or Area = (1 ÷ 2) × l × r.

Length of an Arc

The curve joining the two radii is called the arc. Its length is a fraction of the circle's full circumference: l = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr.

Perimeter of a Semicircle

A semicircle is a special sector with a central angle of 180°. Its perimeter formula simplifies to: P = πr + 2r = r(π + 2).
</p

questions.question: If 3 sin A + 4 cos A = 5, then the value of tan A is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If an equation is of the form a sin A + b cos A = c, and satisfies a² + b² = c².

Then we can directly write the result: tan A = a / b.

Here, a = 3, b = 4, and c = 5.

Since 3² + 4² = 5² (9 + 16 = 25), the condition is perfectly satisfied.

⇒ tan A = 3 / 4

**∴ The correct answer is 3/4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ 3 sin A + 4 cos A = 5

**Formula Used:**

⇒ sin² A + cos² A = 1

⇒ tan A = sin A ÷ cos A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47f3cf31aec376f8a324be6b23f5e0ea171afee6c0d6d54e5bba500f7168e170.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 3 sin A + 4 cos A = 5

⇒ Dividing the entire equation by 5, we get:

⇒ (3/5) sin A + (4/5) cos A = 1

⇒ We know the fundamental trigonometric identity: sin A × sin A + cos A × cos A = 1

⇒ By comparing the two equations directly, we can conclude:

⇒ sin A = 3/5

⇒ cos A = 4/5

⇒ Now, substitute these values to find tan A:

⇒ tan A = sin A ÷ cos A

⇒ tan A = (3/5) ÷ (4/5)

⇒ tan A = 3/4

**∴ The correct answer is 3/4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

General Trigonometric Rule

For any given equation of the form a sin θ + b cos θ = c, if the condition a² + b² = c² holds true, then sin θ = a/c, cos θ = b/c, and tan θ = a/b.

Pythagorean Triplets

A set of three positive integers (a, b, c) that satisfy the relation a² + b² = c². Common examples include (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (7, 24, 25), and (8, 15, 17).

Fundamental Trigonometric Identities

• sin² θ + cos² θ = 1
• 1 + tan² θ = sec² θ
• 1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ
</p

questions.question: A motorboat travelling at some speed can cover 24 km upstream and 40 km downstream in 17 hours. At the same speed it can travel 32 km downstream and 12 km upstream in 10 hours. The speed of the stream is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let downstream speed = D and upstream speed = U.

We have: 24/U + 40/D = 17 and 12/U + 32/D = 10.

Double the 2nd equation and subtract the 1st: 24/D = 3 ⇒ D = 8 km/h.

Substitute D = 8 in 1st equation: 24/U + 5 = 17 ⇒ U = 2 km/h.

Speed of stream = (D − U) ÷ 2 = (8 − 2) ÷ 2 = 3 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**__Additional Information__**

Congruence Criteria

Two triangles are strictly congruent if they satisfy SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, or RHS congruency conditions.

CPCT Theorem

CPCT denotes 'Corresponding Parts of Congruent Triangles'. It establishes that if two triangles are congruent, all their equivalent angles and sides are identical.

Angle Sum Property

The total sum of interior angles in any triangle is exactly 180°. This helps determine the third angle if two are known (∠A = 180° − ∠B − ∠C).

Similar vs Congruent

Congruent triangles have an identical shape and exact size, whereas similar triangles possess the identical shape but may differ proportionally in size.
